about: Off-topic queries for the xerj refusal floor (tools/xerj-query.mjs REFUSE_COS / REFUSE_BM25). Invented 2026-10-12, length-matched to audits/XERJ-BENCH-QUERIES.json (median 14 words). No answer exists in the Tepna corpus. Even indices fit the floor; odd indices are the hold-out.
